issue_title: fix(a11y): correct event landing text contrast and card labels
problem_statement:
fix(a11y): correct event landing text contrast and card labels

Lighthouse13.4.1 on the live All Things AI2027 event page at ATA runtime74f9dd9, before the orange header change, reports accessibility97 on both mobile and desktop. This is a pre-existing page-body issue; the scoped header browser axe checks pass.

Reproduced findings:
- `color-contrast`: “Research Triangle Park” town label in `src/components/homepage/place-triangle-map.tsx` uses `text-white/45`; the “WHOEVER YOU ARE” outro eyebrow in `src/components/homepage/tracks.tsx` also uses `text-white/45` on its dark tinted surface.
- `label-content-name-mismatch`: event-directory cards expose an `aria-label` built from primary action plus event name, while the visible linked card contains further text. Lighthouse flags the2027 conference,2026replays, AI Forward and All Things Open AI2025 cards. See `src/components/events-directory.tsx`, where `actionLabel` is assigned to the wrapping Link.

Acceptance: fix the two demonstrated text contrast failures while preserving the intended hierarchy; give the event cards accessible names consistent with their visible labeling and discoverable descriptions without changing destinations, registration eligibility or replay rules. Verify the actual composed event page at mobile/desktop with axe/Lighthouse, keyboard and assistive-technology naming checks, and cover external recap/imported events plus upcoming/past states. Do not hide text or silence audits to pass.

Evidence: originating Codex task `outputs/Orange-Event-Bar/lighthouse-before/event-mobile.report.json` and desktop equivalent, captured2026-09-14. Related#2032 concerns schedule Grid semantics and is a separate surface. This issue records discovery; it does not claim the fixes are shipped.
